posts.meta_description:
42K likes, 104 comments - sarvesh_shashi on October 24, 2026: "A brother-sister getaway, a full camera roll, and plenty of reasons to fall for Abu Dhabi, this Diwali. 🤍

Getting lost in the lights at teamLab, finding a little stillness at Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, travelling back in time at the Natural History Museum, and coming home to the Ritz-Carlton between it all.

Somewhere in there, we also found time to annoy each other. Naturally. 😂

A quick trip, but so many lovely memories. Abu Dhabi, we clearly need to do this again.

@visitabudhabi #ExperienceAbuDhabi #VisitAbuDhabi #inabudhabi 

Went in for a quick look. Came out with half our camera storage gone. ✨

A little perspective, courtesy of a few million years before us.

One of those places where you put your phone away to take it all in. 

We kept stopping to look. At the detail, the light, the sheer beauty of it all! 

Sshhh. Very busy reading! 🧐

What’s cooking? :P 

A little underwater magic 🐠✨

Could’ve stayed here for hours. Actually, she might still be here if I hadn’t mentioned dinner. 😂

Two very distracted siblings and an entire underwater world stealing the spotlight. 🤍

Some places make you lower your voice and slow your steps. Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque was one of them. 🤍

Our holidays is mostly just asking each other, “What are we eating next?” 😂

Our lovely little base in Abu Dhabi. 

Where are we off to? 🥰🤍

We had questions for the dinosaurs. 🦕

Fully grown adults. Absolutely childlike levels of excitement. 🫧

Levitating 😄".
